newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.25 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Tuesday intervened in the money market with a round of special purchase and resale agreements at 4.25 percent, dealers said.
The overnight lending rate had traded above the top of the 3.75-4.25 percent target range set by Canada's central bank, they said.
Call loan had risen to 4.5 percent before the Bank of Canada intervened, one dealer said.
After the round of specials, the overnight lending rate was bid at 4.25 percent. "There's still a few lookers out there," he added.
The Bank of Canada may intervene with more specials later today, he said.
